reason: I compare price per day, and $0.83 to $1 a day for plain magnesium bisglycinate is a lot when I can get a big bottle of multi-form magnesium for way less. The lab report is a nice touch but it does not make up the gap for me.
objection: Why pay this much for one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule for a lower cost per day?
would_change_my_mind: A price near $0.40 a day or a real coupon or flash sale that gets two boxes well under $40.
